Solutions

Solutions by project type

The same approach, applied to the situations we are usually called into. Each page says what we design for, what we ask the project to decide early, and where the evidence lives.

01

New-build AI data centre

Fix the IT operating limits, the CDU approach and the acceptance criteria before the first rack lands, and plan heat reuse where a buyer exists.

Read 02

Retrofit of an existing hall

Liquid on an air-cooled floor, often without rebuilding the chiller plant, and without inheriting an undocumented loop.

Read 03

Cold-climate deployment

Dry heat rejection and fluid selection for design ambients down to −40 °C. Where we started, now one case among several.

Read 04

Heat reuse and community benefit

Turn reject heat into a metered product at the fence line, and into a benefit the community can see when the next site is proposed.

Read 05

Edge and small-scale

Single-rack to small-pod liquid cooling where there is no facilities team to hand the binder to.

Read

Prefabricated liquid cooling for AI data centres: we plan and design the system, deliver skids, CDUs, ORv3 racks and cooling plant, and test, commission and maintain the liquid loop in the field. Every boundary comes with its evidence.
